d: We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Credit Analyst to join our team in Manama, Bahrain. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in finance, with a minimum of 2 years of experience in credit analysis or related fields. The Credit Analyst will be responsible for evaluating credit data and financial statements of clients to determine the risk involved in extending credit or lending money.
q: Minimum of 2 years of experience in credit analysis or a related field.
Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex financial data.
Proficient in Microsoft Excel and other financial analysis tools.
Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
r: Analyze credit data and financial statements to determine the creditworthiness of individuals or businesses.
Prepare reports that outline the credit analysis findings and present recommendations to management.
Monitor existing clients' credit limits and assess the need for adjustments based on changing financial conditions.
Collaborate with the sales team to provide insights on credit policies and procedures.
Conduct regular reviews of credit portfolios to identify potential risks and opportunities.
Stay updated on economic trends and market conditions that may affect credit risk.
Maintain accurate records of credit analysis and client interactions in compliance with company policies.

Our jobs aren’t just about giving guests a clean room and a freshly made bed. Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique. Our Guest Environment Experts are skilled in a wide range of housekeeping functions with responsibility for maintaining the appearance and cleanliness of the whole hotel. They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done. Whether delivering guest requests, stocking carts, cleaning rooms and public spaces, or other similar responsibilities, the Guest Environment Expert makes sure the spaces in the hotel help create a great guest experience.

No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success – ensuring a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional. Guest Environment Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance). Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Environment Experts – to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.

8–12 years of experience in aerospace/defense project management, with direct exposure to airframe systems.
Proven track record in budget management, scheduling tools (MS Project/Primavera), and risk management.
Excellent communication skills for executive and technical audiences.
MS Project or Primavera for scheduling and resource planning.
ERP systems (SAP or equivalent) for project tracking and reporting.
Risk management platforms for monitoring and mitigation.
Collaboration tools (SharePoint, Teams, or equivalent) for stakeholder communication.
r: Define project scope, objectives, and deliverables for airframe systems.
Develop and manage detailed project schedules, budgets, and risk registers.
Lead cross-functional teams including design, procurement, finance, legal, production, quality and ILS departments.
Monitor the project from initiation up to delivery by day-to-day coordination with all the stakeholders.
Ensure compliance with FAA/EASA certification requirements and defense standards (e.g., MIL-STD).
Support design reviews, testing campaigns, and production readiness.
Act as primary liaison between engineering teams, suppliers, and executive leadership.
